title: Rock Types
description: Common igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks and their uses.

results.name: Granite
results.description: Coarse-grained rock of quartz and feldspar formed from slowly cooled magma.

results.name: Basalt
results.description: Fine-grained, dark volcanic rock that makes up much of the ocean floor.

results.name: Obsidian
results.description: Glassy black rock formed when lava cools too quickly to crystallize.

results.name: Pumice
results.description: Light, porous volcanic rock full of gas bubbles that can float on water.

results.name: Gabbro
results.description: Coarse-grained dark rock, the intrusive equivalent of basalt.

results.name: Andesite
results.description: Fine-grained volcanic rock common in continental arc volcanoes.

results.name: Sandstone
results.description: Rock made of cemented sand-sized grains, often quartz.

results.name: Limestone
results.description: Rock composed mainly of calcium carbonate from shells and marine debris.

results.name: Shale
results.description: Fine-grained rock formed from compacted mud and clay that splits in layers.

results.name: Conglomerate
results.description: Rock of rounded gravel and pebbles cemented together.

results.name: Chalk
results.description: Soft white limestone made of microscopic marine plankton skeletons.

results.name: Coal
results.description: Combustible black rock formed from compressed ancient plant matter.

results.name: Breccia
results.description: Rock of angular, broken fragments cemented in a fine matrix.

results.name: Marble
results.description: Recrystallized limestone prized for its color and smooth texture.

results.name: Slate
results.description: Fine-grained rock derived from shale that splits into thin flat sheets.

results.name: Gneiss
results.description: Banded rock with alternating light and dark mineral layers.

results.name: Schist
results.description: Foliated rock with visible platy minerals like mica that reflect light.

results.name: Quartzite
results.description: Very hard rock formed from metamorphosed quartz sandstone.

results.name: Phyllite
results.description: Foliated rock between slate and schist with a silky sheen.

results.name: Anthracite
results.description: The hardest, highest-carbon form of coal, formed under heat and pressure.
